content: OWASP API1:2023 BOLA: every endpoint that takes an object ID must check the caller can act on THAT object. UI filtering is not enough. Bulk list endpoints that return all users objects are a documented BOLA variant (WSTG). Comparing JWT userId to a client-supplied userId is insufficient. Distinct from BFLA (API5), where a user invokes an admin function they should not have.
